item.title: Ball State fires men’s basketball head coach Michael Lewis
item.description: Ball State announced it is parting ways with men's basketball head coach Michael Lewis after four seasons, during which the team's win total decreased from 20-12 in his first season to 12-19 this season.

item.title: Reports: Colts trade Zaire Franklin to Packers
item.description: The Colts have traded linebacker Zaire Franklin to the Packers in exchange for defensive tackle Colby Wooden.

item.title: 1 dead and 4 people detained after shooting on Indy’s northeast side
item.description: Four people were arrested after a person was shot and found in critical condition on Indy's northeast side early Saturday morning.

item.title: Brief quiet stretch before a strong storm chance this week | Mar. 8, 2026
item.description: Indianapolis has experienced the wettest first 7 days of March in recorded history, with a strong storm and flooding chance expected to hit late Tuesday into Wednesday.

item.title: Juvenile male in critical condition after near west side shooting
item.description: One person is in critical condition after being shot at 1165 N. Tibbs Ave. in Indianapolis, and police are investigating.

item.title: Report: Kicker Blake Grupe, Colts agree to one-year deal
item.description: The Colts have agreed to a one-year deal with kicker Blake Grupe, according to a report on Sunday.

item.title: Drunk driver arrested after hitting security guard and IMPD officer in downtown Indianapolis
item.description: A 28-year-old man was arrested after he hit a security guard and a state trooper with his car while driving drunk, leading to outrage from the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department Chief and a reminder that this type of reckless behavior will not be tolerated.

item.title: Iran’s Supreme Leader’s son named as successor amid ongoing war
item.description: Mojtaba Khamenei has been named the successor of his father, the late Supreme Leader of Iran, and will now have the central say in war strategy, as the war toll on civilian targets continues to rise in the Middle East.

item.title: Seventh U.S. service member dies in Operation Epic Fury
item.description: A U.S. Service member died Saturday night from injuries sustained in an attack on U.S. troops in Saudi Arabia, marking the seventh service member to die in Operation Epic Fury.

item.title: East side shooting leaves a man critically injured
item.description: One person is in critical condition after a shooting on the east side of Indianapolis, according to the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department.
